theme: How India is run — President, Prime Minister, Parliament (simple)

questions.question: Who is the Prime Minister of India (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: The Prime Minister is the head of the government and leads the team of ministers who run the country.

questions.question: Who is the President of India (as of 2026)?
questions.funFact: Droupadi Murmu, who became President in 2022, is the first person from a tribal community to hold the post.

questions.question: India's Parliament has two houses. One is the Lok Sabha. What is the other called?
questions.funFact: The Rajya Sabha is the 'Council of States' and speaks up for India's different states.

questions.question: The President of India lives in Rashtrapati Bhavan.
questions.funFact: Rashtrapati Bhavan in New Delhi has 340 rooms and a beautiful Mughal Garden.

questions.question: India's first Prime Minister was Jawaharlal ___.
questions.funFact: Jawaharlal Nehru loved children, who called him 'Chacha Nehru', and his birthday is celebrated as Children's Day.

questions.question: The Lok Sabha is also known as the ___.
questions.funFact: The people of India vote to choose the members of the Lok Sabha, the House of the People.

questions.question: India became a republic on 26 January 1950.
questions.funFact: We celebrate 26 January every year as Republic Day, the day India's Constitution came into effect.

questions.question: Who was the first President of India?
questions.funFact: Dr. Rajendra Prasad served as India's first President for 12 years, longer than anyone else.

questions.question: Which of these is NOT a part of India's Parliament?
questions.funFact: India's Parliament is made of the President, the Lok Sabha and the Rajya Sabha; the Supreme Court is the country's highest court instead.

questions.question: The members of the Lok Sabha are chosen by the ___ of India.
questions.funFact: Every adult citizen of India can vote, which is why India is called the world's largest democracy.

questions.question: The Prime Minister is the head of the Council of Ministers.
questions.funFact: The Council of Ministers helps the Prime Minister make decisions for the whole country.

questions.question: In which city is India's Parliament located?
questions.funFact: India got a brand-new Parliament building in New Delhi in 2023.
